text:
KEY LINES:
Recruitment Examination, 2024, notified under Advertisement No. PHC/01/2024 are hereby

FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 52/R&A Dated: 22nd July, 2025
All the candidates of Translator and Translator-cum-Proof Reader (For SUVAS Cell)
Recruitment Examination, 2024, notified under Advertisement No. PHC/01/2024 are hereby
informed that the scores of the Written Test held on 08th September, 2024, Computer Proficiency
Test held on 17th April, 2025, test of translation in Urdu/Maithili/Santhali held on 17th June,
2025 as well as Interview held on 16th June, 2025, 19th June, 2025, 20th June, 2025 and 23rd
June, 2025 have been made available on the website of the Court. The candidates may view their
scores by clicking on the link given on Court’s website using their login credentials provided to
them at the time of registration.
The candidates must take notice that the link shall remain active till 31st August, 2025
only.
Besides, in light of Clause 12(xxx) of the above-referred advertisement, no application
under RTI Act, 2005 seeking information relating to scores and cut-off marks of the Translator
and Translator-cum-Proof Reader (For SUVAS Cell) Recruitment Examination, 2024, shall be
entertained.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
